verses.text: A false balance is an abomination to the LORD, But a just weight is His delight.
verses.textZh: 詭詐的天平為耶和華所憎惡；公平的法碼為他所喜悅。

verses.text: When pride comes, then comes dishonor, But with the humble is wisdom.
verses.textZh: 驕傲來，羞恥也來；謙遜人卻有智慧。

verses.text: The integrity of the upright will guide them, But the crookedness of the treacherous will destroy them.
verses.textZh: 正直人的純正必引導自己；奸詐人的乖僻必毀滅自己。

verses.text: Riches do not profit in the day of wrath, But righteousness delivers from death.
verses.textZh: 發怒的日子資財無益；惟有公義能救人脫離死亡。

verses.text: The righteousness of the blameless will smooth his way, But the wicked will fall by his own wickedness.
verses.textZh: 完全人的義必指引他的路；但惡人必因自己的惡跌倒。

verses.text: The righteousness of the upright will deliver them, But the treacherous will be caught by [their own] greed.
verses.textZh: 正直人的義必拯救自己；奸詐人必陷在自己的罪孽中。

verses.text: When a wicked man dies, [his] expectation will perish, And the hope of strong men perishes.
verses.textZh: 惡人一死，他的指望必滅絕；罪人的盼望也必滅沒。

verses.text: The righteous is delivered from trouble, But the wicked takes his place.
verses.textZh: 義人得脫離患難，有惡人來代替他。

verses.text: With [his] mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor, But through knowledge the righteous will be delivered.
verses.textZh: 不虔敬的人用口敗壞鄰舍；義人卻因知識得救。

verses.text: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices, And when the wicked perish, there is joyful shouting.
verses.textZh: 義人享福，合城喜樂；惡人滅亡，人都歡呼。

verses.text: By the blessing of the upright a city is exalted, But by the mouth of the wicked it is torn down.
verses.textZh: 城因正直人祝福便高舉，卻因邪惡人的口就傾覆。

verses.text: He who despises his neighbor lacks sense, But a man of understanding keeps silent.
verses.textZh: 藐視鄰舍的，毫無智慧；明哲人卻靜默不言。

verses.text: He who goes about as a talebearer reveals secrets, But he who is trustworthy conceals a matter.
verses.textZh: 往來傳舌的，洩漏密事；心中誠實的，遮隱事情。

verses.text: Where there is no guidance the people fall, But in abundance of counselors there is victory.
verses.textZh: 無智謀，民就敗落；謀士多，人便安居。

verses.text: He who is guarantor for a stranger will surely suffer for it, But he who hates being a guarantor is secure.
verses.textZh: 為外人作保的，必受虧損；恨惡擊掌的，卻得安穩。

verses.text: A gracious woman attains honor, And ruthless men attain riches.
verses.textZh: 恩德的婦女得尊榮；強暴的男子得資財。

verses.text: The merciful man does himself good, But the cruel man does himself harm.
verses.textZh: 仁慈的人善待自己；殘忍的人擾害己身。

verses.text: The wicked earns deceptive wages, But he who sows righteousness [gets] a true reward.
verses.textZh: 惡人經營，得虛浮的工價；撒義種的，得實在的果效。

verses.text: He who is steadfast in righteousness [will attain] to life, And he who pursues evil [will bring about] his own death.
verses.textZh: 恆心為義的，必得生命；追求邪惡的，必致死亡。

verses.text: The perverse in heart are an abomination to the LORD, But the blameless in [their] walk are His delight.
verses.textZh: 心中乖僻的，為耶和華所憎惡；行事完全的，為他所喜悅。

verses.text: Assuredly, the evil man will not go unpunished, But the descendants of the righteous will be delivered.
verses.textZh: 惡人雖然連手，必不免受罰；義人的後裔必得拯救。

verses.text: [As] a ring of gold in a swine's snout [So is] a beautiful woman who lacks discretion.
verses.textZh: 婦女美貌而無見識，如同金環帶在豬鼻上。

verses.text: The desire of the righteous is only good, [But] the expectation of the wicked is wrath.
verses.textZh: 義人的心願盡得好處；惡人的指望致干忿怒。

verses.text: There is one who scatters, and [yet] increases all the more, And there is one who withholds what is justly due, [and yet it results] only in want.
verses.textZh: 有施散的，卻更增添；有吝惜過度的，反致窮乏。

verses.text: The generous man will be prosperous, And he who waters will himself be watered.
verses.textZh: 好施捨的，必得豐裕；滋潤人的，必得滋潤。

verses.text: He who withholds grain, the people will curse him, But blessing will be on the head of him who sells [it].
verses.textZh: 屯糧不賣的，民必咒詛他；情願出賣的，人必為他祝福。

verses.text: He who diligently seeks good seeks favor, But he who seeks evil, evil will come to him.
verses.textZh: 懇切求善的，就求得恩惠；惟獨求惡的，惡必臨到他身。

verses.text: He who trusts in his riches will fall, But the righteous will flourish like the [green] leaf.
verses.textZh: 倚仗自己財物的，必跌倒；義人必發旺，如青葉。

verses.text: He who troubles his own house will inherit wind, And the foolish will be servant to the wisehearted.
verses.textZh: 擾害己家的，必承受清風；愚昧人必作慧心人的僕人。

verses.text: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life, And he who is wise wins souls.
verses.textZh: 義人所結的果子就是生命樹；有智慧的，必能得人。

verses.text: If the righteous will be rewarded in the earth, How much more the wicked and the sinner!
verses.textZh: 看哪，義人在世尚且受報，何況惡人和罪人呢？
